newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Heavy rains from storm Marco kill two in Nicaragua.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rains from storm Marco kill two in Nicaragua.

text.p: Tropical Storm Marco created flooding that washed away homes in Nicaragua's Pacific coast and northern regions, killing at least two people, Nicaragua civil defence authorities said on Tuesday
One victim was killed in a traffic accident and the other drowned.
Nicaraguans braced for more rains from Marco, which was hovering off the country's northern Atlantic coast and moving slowly to the northeast, meteorologists said.
The tropical depression formed on Sunday off Nicaragua's northeast coast, turning into a tropical storm early on Tuesday.
It was the 13th named storm so far this year during the Atlantic's hurricane season, which formally ends on Nov. 30.
